description: This file defines a dialog for the CKEditor WYSIWYG editor that handles pasting text. It sets up the dialog properties, including size, content, and event handlers for showing, confirming, and setting up the dialog content.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the content when the dialog is shown.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Handles the event when the user confirms the dialog.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the textarea content when setting up the dialog.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Fires a paste event with the entered text when the dialog is confirmed.

methods.name: onLoad
methods.description: Sets up attributes and styles for the textarea when the dialog loads.
